question:
**Find the part of the sentence that contains an error:**

The HR head made the assistant resubmitting (1)/ all the documentation after discovering (2)/ a discrepancy in the date of joining (3)/ for three contractual employees. (4)
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. made the assistant resubmitting is incorrect.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The verb **"made"** is followed by the bare infinitive (base form of the verb) without the word “to.”
 
• Therefore, the phrase **"made the assistant resubmitting"** is grammatically incorrect.
 
• The correct phrase should be **"made the assistant resubmit"**.

Correct sentence: *The HR head made the assistant resubmit all the documentation after discovering a discrepancy in the date of joining for three contractual employees*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In English grammar, certain causative verbs like **make, let, have**, etc., are followed by the bare infinitive (the base form of the verb without “to”).
 
• For example:
 
 
• **Correct:** She made him apologize.
 
• **Incorrect:** She made him apologizing.
